Our findings also suggest that body appreciation may contribute to an increase in positive global well-being in both boys and girls. Despite these limitations, this study contributes to the growing amount of literature on body appreciation providing evidence that supports the one-dimensional structure and reliability of BAS-2.

section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section details the psychometric properties of a Brazilian Portuguese translation of the BAS-2 in Brazilian adolescents, confirming its one-dimensional factor structure and reliability. The study found negative correlations with BMI and positive correlations with life satisfaction, and also noted that boys showed moderately higher body appreciation scores than girls. Limitations include the use of a convenience sample from three Brazilian cities and a cross-sectional design.
